checks.item: (b3) No determinant/scale validation and no verbatim caller envelope in either scope
checks.evidence: CantileverViewMaterializer.InsertReference (:118-130) and StructuralSectionMaterializer.InsertReference (:78-90) only do `new BlockReference(insertion, definitionId)` and AppendEntity. They set no scale or rotation and do no determinant check. A grep for determinant/RackBlockData in both materializers and in StructuralSectionCommandFlow finds nothing. Neither of the two scopes calls RackBlockData.Write.

checks.item: (c) With "Selective" added, RACKPROYECTAR is the only production caller-owned scope creating a Selective definition from a plan
checks.evidence: The Selective drawer entry point is LateralHeaderDrawer.CreateSystemBlock (its `new BlockTableRecord` is at :243). A grep for its callers finds 4. (1) LateralHeaderDrawService.CreateBlock (own lock and transaction); it is followed by a separate jig (PlaceLayout :222-223) or a separate AppendReference transaction (DrawAt :181-182, which has no production caller: `git grep \.DrawAt\(` finds nothing). (2) SystemBlockWriter.CreateBlock (own transaction, then the ViewBlockDraw jig). (3) SystemBlockWriter.CreatePreparedBlock (own transaction, then the RackViewPlacement jig). (4) RackDefinitionCreator.CreateInTransaction, whose only production callers are RackProjectionWriteScope.cs:58/62 (RACKPROYECTAR). Every `new BlockReference` in src was checked: BlockPlacement:142 (AppendReference), BlockPlacement:240 (jig), LateralHeaderDrawer 60/145/308 (nested refs inside definitions), RackDuplicar:311 and RackLayout:250 (clone path, RackCloner DeepCloneObjects), RackLayoutCommands.Fill:454 (reuses the seed definition, creates none), and the Cantilever and StructuralSection materializers (not Selective). The only `new BlockTableRecord` sites are the Cantilever, StructuralSection and LateralHeader drawers and RackCloner.

checks.evidence: (1) Section 1.1, sysvar-backed DB property reads. (3) "There is no other deviation" and "the only user of beforeCommit" are unchanged in rev3. (4) The rev3 header claim "revision 3 applies only AR8-01" matches the observed diff.
